ConnectionStrings.// AisArchive: Set via `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:AisArchive" "..."` -- never here.

AisStream.// ApiKey: Set via `dotnet user-secrets set "AisStream:ApiKey" "..."` -- never here.

Api.// ApiKey: Shared secret for the /api/* endpoints. Set via `dotnet user-secrets set "Api:ApiKey" "..."`.

Cors.// AllowedOrigins: Empty = allow any origin (dev default). Once the real UI has a fixed URL, list it explicitly, e.g. ["http://localhost:3000", "https://your-ui-domain"].
